title: Decoder Content Pack Schema v2.1
description: Versioned, validated content pack for a single Decoder app. Content is platform-neutral; the app resolves assetKeys to @2x/@3x/PDF variants per device (§8.1). v2.1 locks the Chunk Racer mechanic: a target chunk is the prompt and the player picks the streaming word that contains it (targetChunk / correctWord / distractorWords).

id.description: Unique content pack identifier, e.g. chunk-racer-basics-1

version.description: Semantic version of this pack, e.g. 1.0.0

appId.description: Which app this pack belongs to

locale.description: Locale of the content, e.g. en-US

skillIds.description: Skill graph nodes practiced by this pack

alignment.description: Pedagogical alignment metadata for specialists and parents

payload.description: App-specific content. Chunk Racer mechanic (v2.1): the targetChunk is shown as the prompt; the player picks the streaming word that contains it. correctWord contains the chunk; every distractorWord must NOT contain it, guaranteeing exactly one right answer.

targetChunk.description: The chunk prompt shown at the top of the screen, e.g. "at"

correctWord.description: The word that contains the targetChunk, e.g. "cat"

distractorWords.description: Words that do NOT contain the targetChunk. Exactly one correct answer must exist across correctWord + distractorWords.

assetKeys.description: Logical asset keys (e.g. racer_word_cat). The app resolves these to @2x/@3x/PDF variants per device. No pixel filenames in content.

cues.description: Abstract multisensory cues. The app maps these to Core Haptics on iPhone and audio/visual emphasis elsewhere.

minCanvas.description: Complexity hint for layout. The app decides final layout by size class, not device.

enhancedInput.description: Optional input enrichments (e.g. ["pencil"]). Never required; iPhone always has a first-class path.

type.description: Type of abstract cue. The app translates to haptic/visual/audio.
